recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中出現多顆漿細胞：核偏位、染色質呈車輪狀、細胞質深藍並有核旁淡染區（perinuclear hof），數量明顯多於其他白血球，符合漿細胞白血病。
features: Multiple circulating plasma cells in a single low-power field
Eccentric round nuclei with clumped chromatin
Moderate deeply basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear clearing (hof)
Plasma cells outnumber the few neutrophils present
Background red cells without prominent rouleaux in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous circulating plasma cells, which outnumber the neutrophils in this field. The cells have eccentric round nuclei with clumped chromatin and moderate deeply basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear clearing. Background red cells show no prominent rouleaux in this field. Findings are consistent with plasma cell leukemia, which requires ≥5% circulating plasma cells (per current criteria) and should be confirmed by flow cytometry showing clonal CD38/CD138-positive plasma cells.

ddx.vs: Reactive circulating plasma cells are few, accompanied by reactive lymphocytes, and are polytypic by light-chain analysis.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with MYD88 L265P, rather than a uniform plasma cell population.
Reactive lymphocytes have central nuclei, less distinct hof and cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells.
